desc: 柠黄撞墨黑高识别体系，白底主图、霓虹氛围、空白参数位到整箱交付
leaf: 柠檬冰茶能量饮料罐装
name: 柠檬冰茶撞色能量饮料罐装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用高识别撞色剪影一秒抓住点击，作为合规白底主图
用暗场霓虹光迹把提神恢复的抽象主张一秒视觉化
把产品放进极端口渴乏力环境的氛围场景里，让买家自我代入
用金属质感与冷凝水珠证明冰镇新鲜，替换掉原图的商标特写
承接原图参数表的分镜结构，用空表格单元回答规格疑虑而不编造数值
用撕口露出内装单支的外箱收口，消除整箱交付与包装破损疑虑

style.backgroundSystem: one alternating three-field system: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, ink-black neon stage #0B0C10, pale storm-day outdoor field #B9BDC0
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only in one accent color, no filled badges, no seal artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key front-left key with soft fill on packshots, cool skimming accent on macros, hard rim plus long-exposure neon trails only on the dark stage
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-contrast iced-tea beverage commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of saturated lemon yellow #F5DE17, ink black #15130F, sand-beige neutral #C8BFAC and one electric teal accent #4FE0D2, laid over seamless white #FFFFFF packshot fields; neutral-cool studio lighting with bright high-key fronts and crisp specular control on the metal ends; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; one alternating background system of clean white packshot field, ink-black neon stage and pale storm-day outdoor field; stable upright product angle and scale with a blank information band on the body; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible copy or wordmark on the container.
noDrift: no wordmark or graphic mark drawn on the container body
no numbers or measurement units rendered anywhere in frame
style.presentationRules: the single-serve container always stands upright on its base at the same proportion with the cap ring visible, body carries a blank information band and is never redesigned
style.surfaceSystem: glossy mirror table #0B0C10, coarse sand mound #C8BFAC, matte light neutral board #EFEDE7
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, all rendered copy stripped to blank plates
